name: data-platform-schema-describe-tab-result-runtime-depth
salesforceExclusionReason: The fixture proves Glade's local metadata-backed DescribeTabResult model and does not claim hosted Salesforce tab metadata parity.

source.content: List<Schema.DescribeTabSetResult> tabSets = Schema.describeTabs(); System.assert(tabSets.size() > 0); Schema.DescribeTabSetResult tabSet = tabSets[0]; List<Schema.DescribeTabResult> tabs = tabSet.getTabs(); Schema.DescribeTabResult tab = null; for (Schema.DescribeTabResult candidate : tabs) { if (candidate.getName() == 'Accounts') { tab = candidate; } } System.assertNotEquals(null, tab); System.assertEquals('Accounts', tab.getName()); System.assertEquals('Accounts', tab.getLabel()); System.assertEquals('Account', tab.getSObjectName()); System.assertEquals(false, tab.isCustom()); System.assertEquals(tab.isCustom(), tab.custom); System.assertEquals(tab.getUrl(), tab.getMobileUrl()); System.assertEquals('/lightning/o/Accounts/list', tab.getUrl()); System.assertEquals('Accounts', tab.getTabEnumOrId()); System.assert(tab.getColors().size() > 0); System.assertEquals(tab.getColors().size(), tab.colors.size()); System.assert(tab.getIcons().size() > 0); System.assertEquals(tab.getIcons().size(), tab.icons.size()); System.assertEquals(tab.getLabel(), tab.label); System.assertEquals(tab.getMiniIconUrl(), tab.miniiconurl); System.assertEquals(tab.getMobileUrl(), tab.mobileurl); System.assertEquals(tab.getName(), tab.name); System.assertEquals(tab.getSObjectName(), tab.sobjectname); System.assertEquals(tab.getTabEnumOrId(), tab.tabenumorid); System.assertEquals(tab.getUrl(), tab.url); System.assert(tab.equals(tab)); System.assert(!tab.equals(null)); System.assertNotEquals(0, tab.hashCode()); System.assert(tab.toString().contains('Accounts'));
